author: Alex Michaelides
notes: Alex Michaelides’ 'The Maidens' is a psychological thriller set at Cambridge University, where a therapist investigates a series of ritualistic murders tied to Greek mythology and a secretive student group. HBO’s series adaptation promises a dark, atmospheric take on the novel, building on Michaelides’ success with 'The Silent Patient,' with development updates from Vulture indicating a prestige treatment. No cast or release date has been announced, but the project is in active scripting stages. This adaptation is notable for its blend of academic intrigue and suspense, appealing to thriller fans. I recommend reading the book first—its layered mysteries and psychological tension are gripping on the page, and experiencing the twists firsthand will likely make the series more rewarding.
